name: Sky Meadow
tagline: A painted summer sky over a lime meadow: bold white type springs up letter by letter and glossy app cards burst into the air.
description: A bright, anime-painted summer sky and rolling green meadow, shot like a real lens: it racks into focus, tilts and pushes in. Extruded white display type snakes on letter by letter, each letter springing up past its slot and settling, then collapses into the centre while glossy app cards burst out of it, fan open, change their content and drift with the camera. A blur-and-cyan exposure whip hides the cut to a deeper sky, where lighter lines fade up word by word, blur-condense and morph into the closing title.
bestFor: consumer mobile apps and app-store launches
wellbeing, travel, photo and lifestyle products
feature reels that show two or three app screens
social ads and short product teasers
summer campaigns and friendly onboarding films

signature: letter snake: each letter is born small below-right of its slot on a descending trail and springs up past it (overshoot, lift), the tail still oversized while the head has settled
collapse to burst: the settled line rises, its letters converge on the centre and blur away while app cards burst out of that point and fan open
exposure whip: everything accelerates down-left with motion blur, the plate pushes in and blooms cyan-white, a hidden cut lands on a new framing that settles out of the blur
blur-morph: a line condenses (spacing collapses) under blur and the next line resolves from blur with wide word gaps that close
avoid: more than three cards at once

camera: A real lens on a painted plate: opens soft and racks into focus over 12 f, tilts slowly up while the type plays, makes one big ease-in-out tilt and push-in (with the meadow going soft) as the cards rise, then accelerates into the exposure whip. After the hidden cut a new framing settles out of blur and drifts gently; a small dip and push as the closing title grows.

texture.notes: Clean, bright and painterly: anime-style cumulus and grass, a soft sun bloom in the top corner, a cyan haze that comes and goes with focus. Depth of field is the texture: background blur rises whenever the foreground (cards, title) owns the frame.

lighting: High summer daylight from the top-left: a soft white sun bloom, airy cyan haze near the horizon, cards lit flat with soft blue-grey drop shadows; the type has a grey-blue extruded underside and a soft blue cast shadow.
sound: Bright, light beat bed (~125 BPM) under a friendly voice-over; letters land just ahead of the words, the card burst rides a bass hit, content swaps sit on beats, a whoosh peaks on the whip cut.

beats.label: Word collapses, cards burst and fan
Blur and cyan whip to a new sky
Lines fade up, blur-morph, title lifts off

motionSummary: Moves like a sunny app teaser shot through a real lens: letters spring up one by one, cards burst out of the word and fan open, a blur-and-cyan whip carries you to a new sky.

composition: a painted sky over a low, sloping meadow horizon (lower 15–35 % of the frame); everything else floats in the sky
one line of big extruded white type across the upper-middle third, or a cluster of two or three tilted app cards in the centre
after a cut, quieter centred lines of lighter white type over a deeper blue sky
visual.shapeLanguage: soft and rounded: rounded-square app cards (≈14 % corner radius) with thick white frames, pill chips, round icons and arc gauges, cumulus clouds, small butterflies and petals
visual.contrast: bright, high-key and saturated: sky blue and lime green carry the frame, pure white type and card frames sit on top with soft blue shadows; one dark card or widget gives a single punch of contrast

grammar.pacing: brisk and bouncy: a new action every 0.5–1.5 s, holds of 10–20 f only once a line or a fan of cards has settled
grammar.rhythm: springy and staggered: letters on a ≈1.25 f stagger, cards 3–4 f apart, words 3 f apart; everything lands in a ripple, never all at once
grammar.easing: entrances are springs or strong ease-out (most travel in the first 4–6 frames, a long settle); exits ease in and accelerate with blur; camera tilts are ease-in-out; never linear
grammar.acceleration: burst then glide: fast emergence, long soft settle, a slow drift, then an accelerating exit into the next transition
movement: letter snake: born small below-right, springs up past its slot (scale ≈1.3, lifted), settles
collapse: the line rises, letters converge on the centre, blur and fade
card burst: cards scale up from a point with motion blur and fan out to tilted rest angles (−12° … +12°)
live content swap: a card's screen wipes, slides or morphs to its next state
drift: cards and plate drift together with the camera tilt
words fade up from below with blur while the line re-centres
rack focus and push-in on the plate
grammar.density: low to medium: one line or up to three cards, plus a few drifting butterflies; the sky always has room
grammar.holds: short (10–20 f) once a line or the card fan has settled; the plate and butterflies keep drifting so a hold is never dead

transitionPresets.name: Letter snake
transitionPresets.build: each letter starts at 18 % scale, 34 px right and 92 px below its slot (1080p), rotated 22°, and springs into place (letter spring, stiffness 210, damping 14) with an extra sine bump (scale +0.12…+0.28, lift up to 18 px) over its first 10 f; stagger 1.25 f per letter so the tail is still oversized while the head settles; extruded white type with a 4-step grey-blue underside
transitionPresets.sound: light ticks on the first letters, the word lands just ahead of the VO

transitionPresets.name: Collapse to burst
transitionPresets.bridge: the centre point of the line
transitionPresets.build: over 7 f the settled line rises ≈75 px (ease-in-out), its letters converge 70 % toward the line's centre and blur to 10 px (ease-in) while fading tail-last; from frame 1 of the collapse, cards are born at that centre at 2–3 % size and burst out 3–4 f apart, reaching 80 % of their size in 6–8 f with motion blur proportional to speed
transitionPresets.sound: a bass hit on the burst

transitionPresets.name: Exposure whip
transitionPresets.build: over 5–8 f everything on screen accelerates down-left and grows (ease-in), blur 0 → 10 px, the plate pushes in and a radial cyan-white bloom rises to 60 %; hard cut under it to a new framing that starts blurred (15 px) and over-exposed cyan, decaying ease-out to clean in ≈10 f
transitionPresets.sound: a whoosh whose peak sits on the hidden cut

transitionPresets.name: Words fade up
transitionPresets.build: each word starts 45 px below its slot, 90 % scale, blurred 9 px and transparent, and eases up into place over 6 f (ease.enter), 3 f apart; while the words arrive the whole line slides left from its right-heavy start to centre (ease-out over ≈30 f)

transitionPresets.name: Blur morph
transitionPresets.bridge: a blurred line of white type
transitionPresets.build: the outgoing line's spacing collapses (letter-spacing −0.085 em, word gaps halve) while it blurs to 15 px and fades; the incoming line appears blurred 16 px with word gaps of 1.1 em that close to 0.24 em while it sharpens (ease.enter over 10–13 f)

transitionPresets.name: Rack focus
transitionPresets.build: the plate opens (or ends) at 13 px blur with a 40 % cyan haze and racks to sharp over 12 f (ease.enter); reversed as an ending, blur and haze rise while the camera eases back to the opening framing, so a film can loop

archetypes.name: Letter line
archetypes.purpose: the hook: the opening statement or the product name
archetypes.composition: one line of big extruded white display type (cap height ≈ 9–12 % of frame height) across the upper-middle sky, slightly left of centre; meadow horizon low and sloping
archetypes.elements: the line, the plate, two to six butterflies or petals
archetypes.motion: rack focus in, letter snake on, a short hold while the camera tilts up, then the collapse
archetypes.camera: rack focus in, slow tilt up

archetypes.name: Card burst
archetypes.purpose: show the product: two or three screens or features at once
archetypes.composition: three rounded app cards (each ≈ 34 % of frame height) fanned in the centre, back-left to front-right, tilted −10°, +3°, +12°, overlapping by a third
archetypes.elements: cards with thick white frames and soft blue shadows; one light lock screen, one dark album, one white widget (or the product's own screens)
archetypes.motion: burst from the collapsed line, fan open, settle, live content swaps on beats, drift with the camera
archetypes.camera: big ease-in-out tilt and push-in, meadow going soft

archetypes.name: Live card
archetypes.composition: a single card larger in the centre (≈ 45 % of frame height) or the front card of the fan, tilted a few degrees
archetypes.elements: a card whose content changes: a screen that wipes to a new view, a photo stack that slides away for the next photo, an icon that pulses and morphs into a widget with a glowing gauge
archetypes.motion: content changes inside the frame (wipe, slide, morph) while the card keeps drifting

archetypes.name: Sky line
archetypes.purpose: the message: a benefit or the tension in one line
archetypes.composition: one centred line of lighter white text type (≈ 7 % of frame height) with a soft glow, over a deeper blue sky with the clouds low
archetypes.elements: the line and the plate only
archetypes.motion: words fade up from below with blur while the line re-centres; hold; blur-condense out
archetypes.camera: new framing settling out of the whip, gentle drift

archetypes.name: Lift title
archetypes.purpose: the resolution: the promise or the call to action
archetypes.composition: a short centred title, slightly larger than the sky line
archetypes.motion: blur-morphs in with closing word gaps, then rises and grows, accelerating toward the top of frame
archetypes.camera: a small dip and push while the title rises

beats.motion: rack focus in, letters snake on and settle

beats.purpose: the product: two or three screens
beats.motion: cards burst out of the word, fan, change content on beats and drift
a new sky settles out of the whip, the line fades up word by word

beats.purpose: the promise or call to action
beats.motion: the title blur-morphs in and lifts off

sequence.cutRhythm: nearly one continuous shot: a single hidden cut under the exposure whip per 5–8 s; everything else is internal motion, a new action every 0.5–1.5 s on the beat

scenes.action: the sky racks into focus; 'Light as air' snakes on letter by letter, the tail still bouncing as the head settles
the line collapses into its centre and three cards burst out: a lock screen, a dark photo album, a white widget; they fan open while the camera tilts up and the meadow softens
on the beat the lock screen wipes to a stats view, the album's photos slide away for a new one, the widget icon pulses and morphs into a glowing gauge; the fan drifts left
the cards whip down-left into a cyan flash; a deeper sky settles out of the blur and 'Every photo, sorted for you' fades up word by word
the line condenses under blur into 'Try it free', which sharpens as its word gaps close, then rises and grows toward the top

elements.text: two voices: big extruded white display type (Inter Tight 700, tight tracking) that snakes on letter by letter, and lighter white text type (Inter 500) with a soft glow that fades up word by word; short lines, sentence case
elements.logo: on a card (a lock screen or icon) or as the closing title's word; never a corner bug or watermark
elements.icons: round app-style icons inside cards that pulse and morph into widgets
elements.images: the painted plate is the world; product photos live inside cards as tilted stacks that slide and swap
elements.ui: glossy rounded app cards with thick white frames and soft blue shadows; content changes live (wipe, slide, morph); at most three at once
elements.shapes: rounded squares, pills, rings, arc gauges
elements.background: a painted summer sky over a lime meadow with a low sloping horizon; rack focus, tilts and push-ins; deeper blue after the cut
elements.particles: a few small butterflies and petals, defocused, flapping and drifting in the opening scenes only

audio.sync: letters land 1–3 f ahead of their spoken word; the collapse-burst sits on a bass hit; card content swaps on beats; the whip whoosh peaks on the hidden cut; the closing title rises on the last phrase
audio.sfx: soft ticks for letters, a bassy pop for the card burst, small UI clicks for content swaps, an airy whoosh for the whip, a soft swell under the closing rise
